title: SV-12545 - A future as-of date can be picked to see coming aging
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • At least one customer has an open invoice that is not yet due today.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Summary" in the left list.
  3. Click the date chip.
  4. Pick the last day of next month.
  5. Read the date chip.
  6. Find the customer whose invoice is not yet due.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • the last day of next month can be picked.

Step 5:

  • the chip shows that future date.

Step 6:

  • the report is worked out for that date, so an invoice not due today but due before then has moved out of Current into a past-due bucket.
  • EXPECT FAIL. What you should see on the upgraded build today: Every date after today is greyed out in the date menu; the chip stays on today.
  • (1) You see exactly that: mark the test FAILED and raise nothing new. This is a V1-to-V2 capability loss already reported to the QA lead for a Product Owner decision.
  • (2) It fails in a different way: that is a new problem. Mark FAILED, write down exactly what you saw, and report it.
  • (3) It passes: the capability is back. Mark PASSED and tell the QA lead.
  • Existing ticket: none found (Jira searched 11 Nov 2026); task ticket for the PO to be raised only with the QA lead's permission.

Why this matters: Collectors and owners plan cash: "what will be overdue at month end" was answerable before the release.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingSummaryReport.vue:191-201; app/src/components/ts/shared/filters/FilterSingleDatePanel.vue:52-55; api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApAgingSummaryFetcher.php:37-43. This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-013) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) is silent on it. Not yet checked against any build.
